## GameplayFile

GameplayFile is the root of `cfggameplay.json`, the mission-level file for
server-side gameplay rules.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 10 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### GameplayFile.GameplayBaseBuildingData

Key: `BaseBuildingData`

BaseBuildingData controls checks applied when previewing and constructing
base-building objects. Disabling a check permits placements that
thecorresponding rule would otherwise reject.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Required | no |
| Reference | [`GameplayBaseBuildingData`](#gameplaybasebuildingdata) (`#/$defs/GameplayBaseBuildingData`) |

Key: `ExternalLockData`

ExternalLockData configures lockout thresholds and timers that slow repeated
failed attempts to open an external lock.

| --- | --- |
| Required | no |
| Reference | [`GameplayExternalLockData`](#gameplayexternallockdata) (`#/$defs/GameplayExternalLockData`) |

| Required | no |
| Reference | [`GameplayGeneralData`](#gameplaygeneraldata) (`#/$defs/GameplayGeneralData`) |

DynamicMode selects obstruction handling for dynamic objects:

| Required | no |
| Enum | `0`, `1`, `2` |
